issue.title: Agent work lands uncommitted in apollo's primary sase-core checkout, wedging dev updates of the Rust core
issue.description:
Found while diagnosing an ACE crash on apollo (typing `(` raised
`AttributeError: sase_core_rs ... does not expose binding 'argument_list_continuation_edit'`).

Apollo's PRIMARY sase-core checkout (`~/projects/github/sase-org/sase-core`) carries
uncommitted agent work that no workspace owns:

- `M crates/sase_core/src/lib.rs`, `M crates/sase_core_py/src/prelude.rs`,
  `M crates/sase_core_py/src/vcs/mod.rs`, `M crates/sase_core_py/src/vcs/tests.rs`,
  `?? crates/sase_core/src/agent_session_manifest.rs`
- mtimes 2026-10-03 18:19:54–18:24:41 UTC; contents are an early draft of upstream
  `d7f2dbf0 feat(agent-session-manifest): canonical file-set derivation and classification`
  (landed 19:05 UTC; upstream file differs by +22/-49 lines). Timing matches the apollo agent
  for bead sase-1fs.1 (chat `gh_sase_org__sase-ace_run-sase_1fs_1-261003_141455`, workspace
  name `tmp_261003_141553`), which started 14:15 EDT.
- It recurs: the same checkout already holds `stash@{0}: pre-reconverge 20260927T092612Z`,
  a hand stash an agent made to clean an earlier dirty primary.

Effect: `sase update` classifies the core root as `skipped: checkout has local changes`, so
the primary core has been stuck at f50782f7 (5 behind origin/master) since 2026-10-03
14:24 UTC while sase kept fast-forwarding past its `sase-core-revision.txt` pin (2f16dc4a).
The rebuilt extension then lacked newly required bindings. (The update-flow hardening for
that half is planned separately; this bead is about why agent edits land in the primary
linked checkout at all.)

Investigate how an agent run (likely a tmp/`%auto` workspace, not a numbered `sase_<N>`
workspace) resolved sase-core to the primary checkout: `sase repo open sase-core` fallback,
`SASE_LINKED_REPO_SASE_CORE_PRIMARY_DIR` / Justfile `sase_core_dir` resolution, or a provider
writing via an absolute path. Fix the resolution so agent edits always land in a
workspace-private linked checkout, or fail closed. Consider also a guard/doctor check
that flags a dirty primary linked checkout.

task_type_fields.impact: Blocks every dev update of sase-core on the host, so sase advances past its core pin and the TUI crashes on missing bindings; agent work is orphaned in a shared checkout.
task_type_fields.location: apollo ~/projects/github/sase-org/sase-core (primary linked checkout); linked-repo resolution for agent workspaces
task_type_fields.repro:
On apollo: `git -C ~/projects/github/sase-org/sase-core status --porcelain` shows the
dirty files above; `git -C ~/projects/github/sase-org/sase-core status -sb` shows
`master...origin/master [behind 5]`; `tail -n 3 ~/.sase/logs/dev_update.jsonl` shows
`sase-core-rs ... "reason": "checkout has local changes", "status": "skipped"` with
current `0.36.4+1.gf50782f7e.dirty` vs latest `0.36.5+1.g2f16dc4a3`.

issue.creation_reason: Leftover agent edits in the primary sase-core checkout made sase update skip the core for over a day, which led to a stale sase_core_rs and an ACE crash on typing '('; this has happened at least twice on apollo.
